title: Integrating network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and molecular simulation to reveal the mechanism of tert-butylhydroquinone for treating diabetic retinopathy.
authors: Liu, Chaoqun; Ren, Yue; Sui, Xin; Liu, Kaiyang; Zhang, Jianing; Wang, Zian; Li, Yingying; Zhang, Yanling
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学、转录组学和分子模拟研究叔丁基对苯二酚治疗糖尿病视网膜病变的机制，虽涉及分子模拟但核心是药物-疾病靶点网络，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR), a common microvascular complication of diabetes mellitus, is a significant cause of blindness. As one of the crucial factors in the pathogenesis of DR, oxidative stress provides new insights for the treatment of DR. Tert-butylhydroquinone (TBHQ), an efficient phenolic antioxidant, has been proved to inhibit diabetic retina injury. However, the mechanism of TBHQ for DR treatment is still unclear. The present study was designed to investigate the potential mechanism of TBHQ for treating DR. Firstly, the potential targets of TBHQ and DR were selected to construct protein-protein interaction network, which was applied to illustrate the potential mechanism of TBHQ against DR. Combined with transcriptomics and molecular simulation, the potential mechanisms were systematically verified. The results showed that TBHQ inhibited retinal microvascular injury by regulating oxidative stress, inflammation, cell proliferation-death regulation, and vascular system development. The mechanisms of these activities were associated with hypoxia-inducible factor-1 (HIF-1), nuclear factor-erythroid 2 related factor 2 (Nrf2), vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF), forkhead box O (FoxO), phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K)/protein kinase B (AKT), and rhoptry-associated protein1 (Rap1) signaling pathways and their related targets nitric oxide synthase 3 (NOS3), mitogen-activated protein kinase 8 (MAPK8), prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2 (PTGS2), and heme oxygenase 1 (HMOX1). In conclusion, a systematic perspective for the mechanism of TBHQ against DR was revealed by present study which lays a foundation for the application of TBHQ in treating DR.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病视网膜病变（diabetic retinopathy, DR）是糖尿病常见的微血管并发症，是导致失明的重要原因。作为DR发病机制中的关键因素之一，氧化应激为DR的治疗提供了新见解。叔丁基对苯二酚（Tert-butylhydroquinone, TBHQ）作为一种高效的酚类抗氧化剂，已被证明能抑制糖尿病视网膜损伤。然而，TBHQ治疗DR的机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨TBHQ治疗DR的潜在机制。首先，筛选TBHQ和DR的潜在靶点以构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络，用于阐明TBHQ抗DR的潜在机制。结合转录组学和分子模拟，系统验证了潜在机制。结果表明，TBHQ通过调节氧化应激、炎症、细胞增殖-死亡调控及血管系统发育来抑制视网膜微血管损伤。这些活性的机制与缺氧诱导因子-1（hypoxia-inducible factor-1, HIF-1）、核因子E2相关因子2（nuclear factor-erythroid 2 related factor 2, Nrf2）、血管内皮生长因子（vascular endothelial growth factor, VEGF）、叉头框蛋白O（forkhead box O, FoxO）、磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase, PI3K）/蛋白激酶B（protein kinase B, AKT）和棒状体相关蛋白1（rhoptry-associated protein1, Rap1）信号通路及其相关靶点一氧化氮合酶3（nitric oxide synthase 3, NOS3）、丝裂原活化蛋白激酶8（mitogen-activated protein kinase 8, MAPK8）、前列腺素内过氧化物合酶2（prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2, PTGS2）和血红素加氧酶1（heme oxygenase 1, HMOX1）相关。总之，本研究揭示了TBHQ抗DR机制的系统性视角，为TBHQ在DR治疗中的应用奠定了基础。
